correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the 3x3 transfer matrix has eigenvalues 1+sqrt(2), 1-sqrt(2), -1. Exact insertion-matrix traces and a finite cyclic geometric sum give both eigenvalue formulas, including the exceptional frequency-zero scalar term. The support includes the empty and every singleton configuration, so the 2n coordinate covariance is positive definite for all n. Uniform exponential estimates yield the sharp limit 4+2 sqrt(2). Independent direct enumeration checks n=3 through n=9, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Independent sets of cyclic prisms form a natural hard-core sampling ensemble; complete first-coordinate Fourier covariance determines every sharp linear reconstruction energy. The two rail-parity branches and the nontrivial exact limiting squared condition ratio 4+2 sqrt(2) clarify the distinction between a one-cycle model and a two-rail constraint, not merely a sample-size or counting statistic.
